purpose: Teach: 優越/数理/復刊/論説/前項/想起/体現/個所

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、他社への優越的態度を取られなかった
lines.en: Father never displayed superiority over his competitors when he started the business.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Slow, steady delivery. Voice carries weight of memory and admiration. Slight pause between sentences, as if turning over each detail with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは数理的な見方を経営に持ち込まれた
lines.en: Yes. He brought mathematical rigor to the way he managed the company.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Respectful, almost scholarly tone. Each phrase deliberate. Honoring the point being made, not rushing. The tone of someone who learned from what he's describing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社史の復刊を社員に依頼されたぞ
lines.en: And he asked the staff to republish the company history, you know.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic delivery. A slight lift on the memory itself. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone savoring the detail, wanting it to be understood fully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新聞に論説を寄稿された
lines.en: Yes. He even contributed essays to the newspaper about his vision.
lines.style: Quiet, almost wondering tone. Measured cadence. A slight sense of marvel that he did these things—not boasting, but recognizing the scope of it. Respectful restraint.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、契約書の前項にも目を通された
lines.en: He paid attention to every clause in the contract, even the fine print.
lines.style: Firm but warm. The voice of someone who witnessed meticulous care. Not harsh—admiring. A slow, deliberate pace. Slight weight on the word 'every.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に創業の原点を想起させられた
lines.en: Yes. He reminded the staff what the company's founding principles actually meant.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded delivery. Measured pace. A hint of quiet intensity—this mattered, and it shows. The register of someone reflecting on something foundational, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、誠実な経営を体現された方だったぞ
lines.en: He was a man who lived out honest business practice in everything he did.
lines.style: Slow, final tone. The voice of someone summing up a life. Weight and warmth together. Slight pause before the statement, as if it deserves its own moment. Trailing with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約書の細かい個所まで確認された
lines.en: Yes. He reviewed every detail of a contract, down to the smallest provision.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation with underlying clarity. Respectful, steady pace. A sense of closure—this is who he was. Not analytical, but honoring the care he took. Composed, slightly tender.
